# Notes service

Node 20 and PostgreSQL 16. Run the tests with `npm test`.
Deploys from main through GitHub Actions.

content.text:
I read README.md first.

I recommend PostgreSQL because it is the usual choice for this kind of service.

Which database do you use?

A) PostgreSQL (Recommended) - the common default; needs a running server.
B) SQLite - a single file; weak under concurrent writes.
C) MySQL - widely hosted; a second engine to learn.
